attributes.action: Create Clear Early‑Stage Charity Pathways To Support Communities
attributes.additional_details: Early‑stage charity pathways are unclear and inconsistent, causing long delays that prevent community groups from beginning lawful, safe public‑benefit activity. Modernising these pathways will help volunteers support vulnerable people, strengthen communities, improve early intervention, and increase homelessness‑prevention capacity.
attributes.background: Modernise early‑stage charity pathways so community groups can begin lawful, safe public‑benefit activity. Clear national guidance will strengthen communities, support vulnerable people, improve early intervention, and increase homelessness‑prevention capacity.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. We do not know what specific changes you want to make to the existing guidance and process of establishing a charity: https://www.gov.uk/set-up-a-charity

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
